thread:
Hannah P: Hey team 1: AuroraCompute joint perf/W + throughput benchmark. Goal: reproducible numbers we can include in a neutral co-blog and marketplace blurb. Key asks: driver+firmware bundle, kernel tuning window, power sampling methodology, and a clear artifact path.

Diego (Aurora): Happy to partner. We'll provide 2x AC-XL boards, driver v2.7.4, microcode v12. Tarball: https://downloads.auroracompute.example/ac-xl/v2.7.4.tar.gz. Recommend 10Hz steady sampling, 30Hz during kernel-tune.

Marco V: Scope: single-board & dual-board, baseline kernel vs tuned kernel, q4 & q8 runtimes. Metrics: tokens/sec, avg W, perf/W, p50/p95 latency, host CPU%, and tail power spikes. Collect ambient temp.

Priya S.: For publish we need a concise methods paragraph (sensor accuracy, sampling rate, ambient conditions) and an embargo plan for figures. Legal requires non-endorsement language; partner logo allowed with signoff.

Diego (Aurora): We'll include a calibration script and a counter-mapping file (aurora_counter_map.json) to normalize names to Redwood metrics. Also providing a small kernel patch (prefetch + PCIe batching) for the tuning pass.

Hannah P: Infra: propose image redwood/infer:prod-2026-04, kernel 5.19.26, cpufreq=performance, irq affinity pinned. Run template:
```bash
./run_jbench \
  --model gpt-3-small-q4 \
  --seq 2048 \
  --batch 8 \
  --duration 900 \
  --power-sample 10 \
  --out s3://redwood-partnerships/aurora/1778006543/\
```
We'll emit a JSON manifest and raw CSVs.

Marco V: Please ensure frequency scaling disabled and P-states pinned. We'll collect NVML + perf counters: GPU_CLK, MEM_CLK, SM_UTIL, IPC, DRAM_POWER. Also want kernel trace logs during tuning.

Infra Bot: lab-reservation confirmed 2026-05-02 08:00-18:00 UTC (2 boards) :white_check_mark:

Priya S.: Owners: Hannah writeup + methods, Marco metrics + dashboards, Diego deliver drivers+patch+cal script, Infra runs and uploads artifacts. Timeline: Diego sends bundle by Fri EOD; Hannah posts job matrix by Mon; run week 2026-05-02; 3 business days for validation post-run.

Diego (Aurora): We'll also provide q8 runtime build and recommended launch flags. Sending runbook + patch by Friday.

Hannah P: Quick decision: include int8 path? I vote include q8 and q4 only for clarity. Marco: thoughts?

Marco V: +1 q4 & q8. For each config run 3x. Capture cold vs warm KV cache.

Hannah P: Great. I'll drop the checklist and job matrix tomorrow. Thanks all :rocket:
